messages:
alex: Heads up — I'm putting together a new dashboard surface that combines runtime and infra signals for model routes (latency, p99, kv-cache hit, GPU utilization, slot quotas). We need to lock down: 1) what fields are allowed for customer-facing dashboards vs internal only 2) RBAC model for sharing 3) audit logging requirements. Thoughts? :eyes:

maria: Love this. We need a 'customer facing' subset by default, and an 'expanded' view for internal only. Also product needs per-tenant cost breakdown shown to customers, but not raw host ids.

lee: From runtime: we can emit sanitized host tag and shard id hash, but not full hostnames. kv-cache metrics safe. We may need to remove internal errors (stack traces) from customer tiles.

sam: Telemetry note: Prometheus labels are rich; we'll add a transformation layer to strip sensitive labels for external views. Also add a flag in the event envelope: visibility=internal|customer|private

tess: Security requirements: any access to internal view must be logged to audit logs with user, org, reason. We should require 2-step approval for granting internal_view to non-admins. Also ensure export controls (CSV/download) honor visibility. :lock:

juan: Sales/customer success: customers ask for per-model latency, per-route quota usage. They dont need instance ids. Can we provide an 'api-key scoped' view so they'd see only their tenants?

alex: Yes. Proposed RBAC model: roles = admin, infra, viewer, customer_admin, customer_viewer. Default for customer org = customer_viewer only. Internal teams get infra or admin.

alex: sample policy snippet:
```
policy:
  role: customer_viewer
  allow: [routes:list, routes:metrics:view]
  mask_fields: [host, instance_id, internal_error]
  export: false
```

maria: UX: in console sharing modal, show 'visibility' badge (customer/internal), and show audit checkbox 'log access to org audit'. People should be able to share dashboards with other orgs? no for internal-only tiles.

lee: runtime work items: add visibility label to metrics pipeline, add mask rules to metrics-processor, maintain mapping table for routes -> allowed fields.

sam: telemetry will surface a 'masked' flag per metric, and a 'source' tag. We'll also add a 'consent' dimension to respect tenant privacy opt-outs.

tess: One more: retention policy differences. Internal logs need 13 months, customer-facing telemetry 90 days. That needs policy in data lake.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: flag dashboard_visibility_v2 enabled in staging for team alex, maria

alex: Cool. Action items:
- lee: create runtime PR to add visibility label + mask rules by EOW (1719080000)
- sam: add telemetry transform + consent tag, and doc of exported fields
- tess: write audit gating doc and approval flow
- maria: mockups for sharing modal with badges
- juan: compile customer requests and send matrix

maria: ack
lee: ack
sam: ack
juan: will collect
tess: starting doc
